events.title: Deep Frost launches October 27
events.summary: Deep Frost, a single-player social-deduction horror game, launches on Steam on October 27. Twelve researchers are trapped at a failing Antarctic station, and something among them is not who it claims to be. Question the crew, compare what they tell you with camera, badge and station records, keep notes, and decide who to trust before each vote. A contradiction is a lead, not proof. events.title: Deep Frost is in Steam Next Fest: play the free demo
events.summary: Deep Frost is a single-player social-deduction horror game set in a failing Antarctic research station. A parasitic intelligence called the Thaw is copying the crew, and the crew votes on who to purge. The free demo is part of Steam Next Fest, from October 19 to October 26. It covers Days 1 to 3 and ends after Night 3. In the demo you play as Crew. Question the crew, check station records and compare accounts in the Case File. events.title: Deep Frost update: clearer clues and smoother play before Next Fest
events.summary: A new update is live for the free demo and the full game (launching October 27). Thank you to everyone who played and sent feedback. Clearer investigation Night alibis now line up with the incidents they describe, so the contradictions you find are the real ones. Early guidance points you to crew you have not talked to yet, and no longer presents yesterday's incidents as fresh leads. Read alibis, strange votes, private whispers, planted clues, and who benefits when the station starts falling apart. The free demo covers Days 1-3.
